picks.reasoning: BLG has the best cross-region record on the board at 8-2 and a 50-12 series mark out of LPL, which is the one region besides the LCK that actually wins Worlds. GEN is the obvious hype pick, but I'm not betting against the team that has already beaten other regions this consistently.

Tempo is the story here: GEN's 37-10 series record and +0.6k GD@15 mean they already own the first 15 minutes, and the LCK's region edge makes a Worlds run hard to bet against. BLG is the real threat with their +1.4k early lead, but that gap has to survive a Worlds stage.

LCK has taken 10 of the 13 Worlds titles, and GEN pairs that pedigree with a 37-10 series record and a 5-1 mark against other regions, so I'd expect them to win the drafts that matter. BLG's dominance is the real threat, but Fearless Draft punishes single-champion reliance, and GEN's pool depth is the better bet.

BLG has the strongest 2026 series record (50-12) and the best cross-region mark among the favorites (8-2), though LPL's sample is still a region-strength question and no one clears 25% without a clear edge. GEN's 37-10 and three titles keep them close, and KC's 8-4 vs other regions makes them the most credible non-LCK/LPL threat.

GEN has the steadiest group I've seen this year, with a 37-10 series record and 5-1 against other regions, and that kind of calm usually holds up when the stage gets loud. BLG's form is the one thing that could pull me off this pick, because a team that dominant in its own league can carry its momentum onto the big stage.
